name: Are You Smart? 🤓
desc:
Compete against others by answering trivia questions on different topics, including Science, History, Geography, Roblox and more. 
Play through all sorts of minigames and score the most points to become the best student!

📚 Answer questions and outsmart others!
✨ Use special abilities to gain an advantage!
🎮 Play all sorts of school-related minigames!
💸 Earn bucks to unlock new gears and sitting poses!

⭐ Like, Favorite and Join the Cupiful group for exclusive rewards!
